description: Record or reinforce a directed cause-and-effect link in the project root-cause graph, returning updated edge confidence and observation counts. Use when logging newly verified bug causes or system dependencies; use `oxyo_causal_infer` to query paths.

action.description: Relationship verb connecting cause to effect (e.g. 'causes', 'prevents', 'triggers').

cause.description: Upstream trigger component, config change, or condition (e.g. 'missing_db_index').

effect.description: Downstream symptom, failure mode, or system outcome (e.g. 'checkout_timeout_504').

polarity.description: Direction of influence: 1 if cause increases/triggers effect, -1 if it prevents/reduces it.

scope.description: Project/repo scope for isolating causal graphs (defaults to 'global').

succeeded.description: True if the link was confirmed in practice; False to down-weight a refuted hypothesis.

name: oxyo_causal_record
